verdict.rationale: Skyfire supports per-agent scoping and spend caps: keys are scoped to a single agent, and pay tokens carry a committed amount ceiling that bounds spend and rejects overcharges. However, the docs explicitly state there is no per-token revocation API and that deactivating an account does not void already-issued tokens — in-flight tokens remain chargeable until expiry plus a 24-hour grace window — directly contradicting 'instant' revocation of payment authority. missing for 10: a documented instant per-agent/per-token revocation mechanism, independent or hands-on confirmation of revocation behavior, and granular usage-limit controls beyond token amount/expiry.
